# Gordon Greco LLC

> Pre-registration planning and research for connected financial decisions.

Gordon Greco LLC was founded by Markos Terzidis. It helps business owners, complex families, pre-retirees/retirees, and US/Greece households organize tax, investment, retirement, estate, and business questions into decision-ready analysis.

Gordon Greco LLC is not a registered investment adviser and does not represent that regulated investment advisory services are currently available. Public website content is informational and is not investment, tax, or legal advice.

## Pages

- https://gordongreco.com/ — audience, process, fees, disclosures, and next step
- https://gordongreco.com/services.html — situation-led service comparison
- https://gordongreco.com/services/business.html — entity, compensation, cash-flow, and owner/household analysis
- https://gordongreco.com/services/tax.html — tax scenario research and professional coordination
- https://gordongreco.com/services/investment.html — tax-aware investment research; no active regulated management
- https://gordongreco.com/services/retirement.html — contribution, claiming, spending, withdrawal, and tax sequencing
- https://gordongreco.com/services/estate.html — ownership, beneficiary, liquidity, and counsel coordination
- https://gordongreco.com/about.html — founder and evidence-first method
- https://gordongreco.com/contact.html — introductory call and public inquiry form
- https://gordongreco.com/client.html — noindex orientation page; no public sign-in or upload

## Commercial context

- Planning and research: scoped fee stated in writing before an engagement.
- Planned investment-management fee: 1% annually, billed 0.25% quarterly, only after registration status, custody, agreements, and operating workflow are verified.
- Introductory call: 30 minutes; no account transfer or sensitive document upload.

Contact: markos@gordongreco.com
